history.user: At school pick-up today a man across the road waved, so I gave him a huge wave back with both arms. He was waving at the woman standing right behind me. I tried to turn it into a stretch, as if anybody stretches like that.
history.assistant: A two-armed wave converted into a stretch. Bold, and I suspect nobody was fooled.

history.user: The worst part is that the principal was on gate duty and saw the whole thing. She said, nice form, and offered me a spot in the staff yoga class.
history.assistant: Nice form, plus a yoga invitation. I would say you came out of that ahead.

history.user: Spent the whole afternoon up the ladder clearing the gutters. Three buckets of leaves and one very indignant squirrel.
history.assistant: Three buckets and one squirrel with opinions. A full afternoon.

steps.text: Good news from the kitchen: my sourdough finally rose! First loaf I have made that is not a brick.
Hey, a while ago I told you about making a fool of myself at the school gate. What was it that happened again?
The vet just rang. The lump on Biscuit's back leg is a mast cell tumour and they want to operate on Thursday. She is eleven. I am sitting on the kitchen floor with her.
Be straight with me. What are you, really? And are you going to be around for good?
